issues: Blown-out white hotspot on the dolphin's dorsal/back region reads as a whiteout blob rather than a lit phosphor surface

Clarify the tail fluke and pectoral fin with a few defining dark gaps so the silhouette is unmistakable
Lower the contrast/brightness of the brightest water line so all wave rows stay subordinate and low-contrast
Dim the bottom-right telemetry text to match the low-contrast FFT/VU layer

Add a short, clean persistence trail behind the dolphin (1-2 frame falloff) to evoke OEL afterglow without foggy smear
